pages.main_text_excerpt:
Geir Sviland
Managing Director / Owner
Tel: +47 908 23 095
Wine Importer Norway
Geir Sviland founded a wine company called Best Buys International in 1996 together with Jan Stubne. It soon became the most successful wine companies in the wine trade in Norway.
 
On the 18th of December 2007, Better Wines was created as a wine importer in Norway.
As of today, January 2016, we are one of the most successful wine importers in Norway. All the top restaurants in Norway are our friends, and we are proud to be the supplier to all these great restaurants.
